home.a: King Rock Cannabis is at 1220b King St W (look for unit B on the King Street frontage), between King West and Liberty Village. The walk-in is open 24 hours daily for adults 19+ with photo ID.

delivery.q: Does King Rock do weed delivery near me in Liberty Village?
